name: ov2640_dvp24
title: OV2640 camera on a 24-pin ribbon
description: An OV2640 with its lens on a ribbon of 24 contacts at 0.5 mm: the parallel port for the picture, SCCB for its registers
notes: Sold with ESP32 camera boards such as the ESP32-WROVER-DEV: it has no price of its own here.
It has no regulators: the board gives it 1.2 V, 2.8 V and the voltage of its port on DVDD, AVDD and DOVDD.
The contacts are those of the HDF3M-811 of Freenove's kit; the ribbon of another maker may be wired another way.

picture.source: a photo by Anton of his camera, 2026-11-06

contacts.source: HDF3M-811, the specification of the OV2640 camera in Datasheet/OV2640 of github.com/Freenove/Freenove_ESP32_WROVER_Board
